lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed as a series of roughly linear longitudinal rows of high-luminance circular clusters extending from the post-cephalic region to the caudal peduncle, with a higher spatial density observed in the anterior trunk.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the longitudinal rows of spots, forming a fragmented grid-like lattice across the dorsal and lateral surfaces.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent median longitudinal ridge and at least one pair of lateral carinae are visible, defined by sharp light-to-shadow transitions running parallel to the body axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of approximately 6-10 high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered toward the leading edge and base of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly localized cluster of maximum-intensity white pixels is visible at the distal tip of the ventral lobe of the caudal fin.
